name: RoundTripVest
concept: The route (b)/(c) fixture: Bohemia's sample vest (Arma Reforger Samples, APL) with its hand-made weights thrown away, skinned again from the base body by the fit stage, exported with LODs and FireGeo pieces, imported, and worn through the vanilla Lifchik vest's prefab. A vanilla mesh cannot be taken out of its .xob, so the sample is the vanilla-made mesh the round trip can use. Not a garment for the game: the generated files are not committed.
